descriptions.rgb: The scene is a large indoor gymnasium with a wooden floor, a curved blue-and-yellow wall beneath an elevated balcony above, a background basketball hoop about 15–18 metres away, and a portable badminton net extending from a near post roughly 5–6 metres in front-left of the camera wearer to a far post about 10–11 metres ahead. Within arm's reach (~0.3–0.6 metres in front and below), the camera wearer holds a badminton racket that is raised in the lower-right foreground in frame 1 (partially occluding the court floor), drops mostly out of view at the bottom edge in frames 2–4, and is held low in front in frame 5 as the viewpoint pitches downward, cutting off the upper ceiling. Beyond the net, four other people—each with a racket within their own arm's reach—occupy the court: two on the left side of the net and two on the right side, none of whom look directly at the camera wearer. On the left side, a player in black stands 11–13 metres away facing right toward the net across all frames, while a teammate in a light-blue shirt (~8–10 metres away, 2–4 metres to his right) crouches in frame 2 and then moves rightward toward the center across frames 3–5, becoming partially occluded behind the net post and mesh as he bends down near the far post in frame 5. On the right side, a player in a red shirt starts ~7–8 metres away facing left toward the net in frame 1, then retreats rightward in frame 2 to stand within arm's reach (<0.5 metres) of a teammate in black (~9–10 metres away) such that the two partially occlude each other through frame 4, before separating to ~1 metre apart in frame 5 with the black-shirted player facing toward the front-left and the red-shirted player facing away toward the back wall.
